tool: scripts/ship-textures.mjs kinds --provider=gemini (per-ship cells) and patch --provider=gemini (1805 sails); scripts/draw-flags.mjs (vector flags, no model)
prompts: src/ships/build/kindAtlas.json (hull_plank, red_paint, black_paint, stern_panel of 19 ships, each followed by the KIND_SUFFIX line and the layout style line); atlasLayout.json sail_canvas and sail_cross of britain, france, spain1805
costNote: Estimate (~0.067 USD per 1024px Gemini image); 76 per-ship cells + 4 pilot retakes of firstrate + 7 retakes (vertical boards, backgrounds round the sterns, the Ark Royal livery) + 6 sails. The script does not log usage.
published: public/textures/ships/kinds/<kind>_{albedo,normal,rough}{,_1k}.webp (19 ships, 2048 + 1k sets) and the patched navy atlases public/textures/ships/{holyleague,britain,france,spain1805}_*.webp
